clips.text: You run a pharmaceutical business. Your supplier is an ocean away.
Chances are, some of the medicines you need are made in India.
Between you: time zones, emails… and a stack of documents.
From far away, every promise sounds the same.
So we made India closer… one check at a time.
We find W-H-O G-M-P certified partner manufacturers in India.
We check their licences and documents.
We don't make medicines. We make sourcing them from India simple.
Each shipment carries the manufacturer's batch certificate of analysis.
Our team assists you from sourcing in India all the way to your door.
One thread… India is closer than you think.
Send us your product list on WhatsApp… our team in India is ready.
